exercises.instruction: Create a shebang line for a bash script
exercises.instruction_id: Buat shebang line untuk script bash
exercises.hint: Shebang tells the system which interpreter to use
exercises.hint_id: Shebang memberitahu sistem interpreter mana yang digunakan

exercises.instruction: Write a script that echoes 'Hello World'
Write a script that takes a name argument and greets
exercises.instruction_id: Tulis script yang menerima argumen nama dan menyapa

exercises.instruction: Write a script that checks if a file exists
exercises.instruction_id: Tulis script yang cek apakah file ada
exercises.shadow_text:
#!/bin/bash
if [ -f '$1' ]; then
    echo 'File exists'
else
    echo 'File not found'
fi
exercises.hint: -f checks if file exists, -d checks directory

exercises.instruction: Write a for loop that prints numbers 1 to 5
exercises.instruction_id: Tulis for loop yang print angka 1 sampai 5
exercises.shadow_text:
#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..5}; do
    echo $i
done

exercises.instruction: Write a while loop that counts down from 3 to 1
exercises.instruction_id: Tulis while loop yang hitung mundur dari 3 ke 1
exercises.shadow_text:
#!/bin/bash
count=3
while [ $count -gt 0 ]; do
    echo $count
    ((count--))
done
echo 'Blast off!'
exercises.hint_id: -gt berarti 'lebih besar dari', -lt berarti 'lebih kecil dari'

exercises.instruction: Write a function that adds two numbers
exercises.instruction_id: Tulis fungsi yang menambah dua angka

exercises.instruction: Write a script that backs up a file with timestamp
exercises.instruction_id: Tulis script yang backup file dengan timestamp

exercises.instruction: Write a script that reads user input
exercises.instruction_id: Tulis script yang membaca input user
exercises.hint: read -p shows a prompt before reading input
exercises.hint_id: read -p menunjukkan prompt sebelum baca input

exercises.instruction: Write a script that exits with error code 1 on failure
exercises.instruction_id: Tulis script yang exit dengan kode error 1 saat gagal
exercises.shadow_text:
#!/bin/bash
if [ ! -f 'config.txt' ]; then
    echo 'Config missing!'
    exit 1
fi
